اعتورتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَوَرْتُنَّ (iʕtawartunna) /iʕ.ta.war.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# اُعْتُوِرْتُنَّ (uʕtuwirtunna) /uʕ.tu.wir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
